title: Three Brothers Hid 1,200 Refugees in a Forest for 2 Years
description:
The Bielski brothers built and defended a hidden forest community that sheltered around 1,200 Jewish refugees for over two years during WWII in occupied Belarus.

Did you know this actually happened? Let me know in the comments.
